scope: EFSA practical arrangements on the pre-submission phase and public consultations (Transparency Regulation, Article 32b GFL): which studies must be notified, when, the information the applicant gives at submission (pre-application IDs, study IDs, justifications) and the verification EFSA performs when assessing validity, with its procedural consequences. Applies to every regulated-product area where EFSA assesses validity. Chapters on general pre-submission advice, renewal advice and public consultations are not encoded.

guidance.title: Decision of the Executive Director laying down the practical arrangements on pre-submission phase and public consultations
guidance.author: European Food Safety Authority (Executive Director)
guidance.citation: EFSA, 2021. Decision of the Executive Director of the European Food Safety Authority laying down the practical arrangements on pre-submission phase and public consultations (implementing Articles 32a, 32b and 32c of Regulation (EC) No 178/2002 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2019/1381).

guidance.title_check_phrase: LAYING DOWN THE PRACTICAL ARRANGEMENTS ON PRE-SUBMISSION PHASE AND PUBLIC CONSULTATIONS
guidance.page_numbering: guidance_page is the PDF page number.

entries.title: Studies commissioned or carried out from 27 March 2021 must be notified
entries.requirement: The notification obligations of Article 32b(2) and (3) GFL apply to studies commissioned or carried out as of 27 March 2021.
entries.quote: Obligations of Article 32b(2) and (3) of the GFL Regulation shall apply to studies that are commissioned or carried out as of 27 March 2021.
guidance_anchors: shall apply to studies that are commissioned or carried out as of 27 March 2021

entries.title: Notified before the study starts, or delay justified
entries.requirement: Every study notification is submitted before the study starting date; a later notification needs a justification for the delay at submission.
entries.quote: All study notifications shall be submitted before the starting date of the study. [...] For any study notification submitted after the starting date of the study, when submitting the application, the applicant shall provide justifications for the delay.
guidance_anchors: All study notifications shall be submitted before the starting date of the study.
the applicant shall provide justifications for the delay

entries.title: Pre-application IDs and study IDs given at submission
entries.requirement: With the application the applicant indicates all pre-application IDs associated with the notified studies and the study ID of each study submitted.
entries.quote: all pre-application IDs provided to the applicant [...] study IDs generated by the database for each study submitted in the application
guidance_anchors: all pre-application IDs provided to the applicant
study IDs generated by the database for each study submitted in the application

entries.title: Justifications for deviations
entries.requirement: Where needed, the applicant justifies studies included but not notified, studies notified but not included, withdrawn notifications and late notifications.
entries.quote: justifications explaining the non-notification in the database of studies that have been included in the application
guidance_anchors: justifications explaining the non-notification in the database of studies that have been included in the application

entries.title: All notified studies included, no unnotified studies
entries.requirement: EFSA verifies that the application contains every previously notified study and no study that was not notified.
entries.quote: the application contains all studies that have been previously notified in accordance with Section 1, and [...] the application contains no additional studies apart from those previously notified in accordance with Section 1.
guidance_anchors: the application contains all studies that have been previously notified in accordance with Section 1
the application contains no additional studies apart from those previously notified in accordance with Section 1

entries.title: Not valid: re-submission and six-month delay
entries.requirement: Unless Art. 22(3) is met or deviations are validly justified, the application is not valid; once re-submitted, its assessment starts six months later.
entries.quote: informed that the assessment of such a re-submitted application shall commences six (6) months after the re-submission of the application
guidance_anchors: shall commences six (6) months after the re-submission of the application
